keywords: ACDE #234 开放 Hegotá 非头号 EIP 提案并计划原生 AA 专场
summary: ACDE #234 宣布 bal-devnet-3 上线，glamsterdam-devnet-0 视 epbs-devnet-1 稳定情况目标下周；Hegotá 非头号 EIP 提案开放，账户抽象方面计划原生 AA 专场，并展示 benaadams 的 ERC-8221 钱包产权契据（由 NFT 控制的智能账户）。rakita 为 EIP-8175 加入 TX_GAS_LIMIT 操作码，提交并合并。

items.title: ACDE #234
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #19：Glamsterdam 的 bal-devnet-3 已上线，epbs-devnet-1 有多个问题在排查，glamsterdam-devnet-0 若 epbs-devnet-1 稳定则下周上线，否则继续分开的执行层与共识层 devnet；Hegotá 非头号 EIP 提案开放，计划原生账户抽象讨论与专场；讨论历史数据最短保留期（2 周到 1 年）与 SFI 定义澄清。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #19: Glamsterdam's bal-devnet-3 launched, epbs-devnet-1 has several issues under investigation, and glamsterdam-devnet-0 goes next week if epbs-devnet-1 is stable, otherwise separate execution and consensus devnets continue; Hegotá non headliner proposals opened with native account abstraction discussion and a breakout planned; history retention minimums (2 weeks to 1 year) and an SFI definition clarification were discussed.
